title: Log entries carry the details an error needs: stack, cause, where it came from
notes: Shipped in #248: log entries carry error { name, message, stack (cut at 2000), code, cause }, source, build, action, channel and context ids. Old entries still read, and unknown levels, kinds and keys are kept. A throwing IPC handler logs its channel, action and main's stack, each sentence once a minute. The status bar's log line carries the renderer Error's stack through failureText. Not done: main's own uncaught failures are still logged without main's stack.
